eligibility.quote: With mavros version >= 0.33 I was actually still sending mavlink v2.0 messages even after successfully setting the fcu_version=v1.0.

failed_conditions.quote: With mavros version >= 0.33 I was actually still sending mavlink v2.0 messages even after successfully setting the fcu_version=v1.0.

loudness.quote: I also looked at the messages with [this](https://mavlink.io/en/guide/wireshark.html) wireshark plugin to double check.

notes: Verified against mavros issue #1787 and PR #1794. libmavconn stored protocol version flags in m_mavlink_status but framed outgoing packets using m_parse_status, causing v2 framing to be sent despite v1 configuration.
